subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

ca_b_ _ac_bc_cbb
solution:
Given: c a _ b _ _ a c _ b c _ c b b

By checking options,

(1) c c b a c → c a c b c / b a c a b / c c c b b

(2) c a b c c → c a c b a / b a c c b / c c c b b

(3) c c a a b → c a c b c / a a c a b / c b c b b

(4) c b c b a →c a c b b / c a c **b **b / c **a **c b b

 
• Here, '**cbcba' **is repeated

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4" .**
